status: Original choreography r3 WIP; revised from Elara r2 feedback; Elara re-review pending
rotation_order: Rx @ Ry @ Rz in camera coordinates
interpolation: Monotone piecewise cubic Hermite (PCHIP) through compression shoulders, with zero endpoint tangents and zero tangent at extrema. Sampled at native 60 fps into derivative-matched cubic Bezier root channels. No shoulder overshoot and no independent world trajectory.
source_evidence: The supplied locomotion videos contain no usable first-person jump sequence. These beat poses and timings are original artistic choices, not reference measurements.
camera_motion: None. Gameplay supplies the world jump arc and existing camera landing_kick. Only the held rig moves relative to the unchanged review camera.

jump_takeoff_r3.purpose: Deeper takeoff inertia carried through broad compression shoulders around the unchanged frame-4 peak; frame-8 rebound and frame-11 ready retained

jump_air_r3.purpose: Identical ready endpoints; statically hold or repeat for any remaining flight time, without bob or a baked world arc

jump_land_r3.purpose: Deeper landing compression with broad held-rig shoulders; frame-4 peak, frame-10 rebound and frame-17 settle retained

runtime_contract.trigger: Accepted normal jump only; exclude mantle and stance-to-stand or rejected Space input
runtime_contract.transition: Takeoff then extendable quiet air; landing starts from real ground contact, not the nominal 0.6245-second flat-flight timer
runtime_contract.short_flight: Integration owner must blend an interrupted takeoff into ground-contact landing without a snap
runtime_contract.grounded_camera_kick: Preserve existing game camera behavior; do not add any new camera motion from these clips
runtime_contract.ADS: The source Actions are absolute HIP poses. ADS needs aim-safe viewmodel-relative composition on the separate existing ADS base; do not replace its articulation or clear ADS intent
runtime_contract.gameplay_authority: No input, movement, firing, reload, ADS or mantle behavior is modified by this source package

feedback.requested_change: Deeper and wider takeoff and landing arcs at the existing phase beats, rather than a taller short spike; preserve quiet air, split and neutral endpoints
feedback.changes: Add broad compression shoulders with monotone Hermite interpolation around unchanged main peaks; increase bounded downward displacement/pitch; preserve existing rebound, lateral/roll, phase duration and quiet air

revision_rationale.note: Broad shoulders retain compression into recovery instead of a narrow impulse. Main peak/rebound/end frames remain unchanged. Monotone interpolation carries velocity through shoulders; only extrema/ends stop. Added landing pitch and reduced backward translation preserve receiver framing while deepening the forward-muzzle arc. Original choreography, no reference-match claim.
